rule.name: SpringPagedCollectionFetch
rule.message: Load a page of ids first and fetch the collection for those ids in a second query (where o.id in :ids), or load it with @BatchSize or @Fetch(FetchMode.SUBSELECT): a paged query that fetches a collection cannot be limited in SQL, so Hibernate reads every matching row and cuts the page in memory (HHH90003004).

property.name: xpath
property.value: //MethodDeclaration [FormalParameters/FormalParameter/ClassType[pmd-java:typeIs('org.springframework.data.domain.Pageable') or pmd-java:typeIs('org.springframework.data.domain.Limit')] or ResultType/ClassType[pmd-java:typeIs('org.springframework.data.domain.Slice')]] /ModifierList/Annotation [(pmd-java:typeIs('org.springframework.data.jpa.repository.Query') and not(AnnotationMemberList/MemberValuePair[@Name = 'nativeQuery']/BooleanLiteral[@True = true()]) and matches(lower-case(string-join(AnnotationMemberList/MemberValuePair[@Name = 'value'] //StringLiteral/@ConstValue, ' ')), 'join\s+fetch\s')) or (pmd-java:typeIs('org.springframework.data.jpa.repository.EntityGraph') and AnnotationMemberList/MemberValuePair[@Name = 'attributePaths'])] | //MethodCall[@MethodName = ('setMaxResults', 'setFirstResult')] /descendant::MethodCall[@MethodName = ('createQuery', 'createSelectionQuery')][1] [*[1][pmd-java:typeIs('jakarta.persistence.EntityManager') or pmd-java:typeIs('javax.persistence.EntityManager') or pmd-java:typeIs('org.hibernate.query.QueryProducer')]] [matches(lower-case(string-join(ArgumentList/*[1]/descendant-or-self::StringLiteral/@ConstValue, ' ')), 'join\s+fetch\s')]
